title: Excavation, backfill and neighboring foundations at Edmonton house project (Council Order 2021-09)

facts.text: The order concerns suspended permits for a single detached house with a rooftop deck/hot tub and a garden suite, and conditions related to adjacent properties during excavation/backfill.
The hearing record includes geotechnical and structural engineering reports, survey-elevation requests, backfill testing/inspection, and a cold-weather foundation-protection plan.
facts.locator: PDF pp.2-4, order text and record

facts.text: The order reports disagreement over excavation sloughing, backfill timing/material and how to protect two neighboring properties; the decision identifies work and access conditions that needed clarification.

limitations: Referenced geotechnical and structural reports are not included as separate attachments.
